cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not That Subject
cards.instruction: Choose one subject you cannot let the scene reach. Redirect whenever the conversation gets close.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. I've booked your car into that garage with the café. Shall we have breakfast there? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does my car need a garage?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Their full breakfast includes unlimited toast. You always say that's important.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll look at the car while you order.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's take the bus. Then we can both have the breakfast cocktails.

mechanism: A presents competent management of a pleasant adjacent task, then adapts that task to B participation to divert from one protected subject.
confusable: Distinguish random topic changes from repeated redirection whenever B nears the same car-condition or rent-status question; confidence must lean on cooperation.
comparison: Garage breakfast redirects damage inquiry through meal choices; curtain photo redirects rent inquiry through house presentation.
seedUse: Canonical garage/cafe and rent/curtain seeds supply forbidden subject and nearby task; avoid contradictory transport logistics or arbitrary unprepared obstacles.
